Monthly ops stayed solid across check-ins, handovers, and route planning, with the senior coordinator keeping decisions tight and practical. The team treated each journey as a shared job, and that kept the handoffs clean and the paper trail tidy.

On the service side, the biggest win was calm coordination. <<FACT F050>> We also kept a close eye on carrier fit, documentation, and traveler updates, which cut down on last-minute scrambles. Liam Wilson and Diego Petrov both moved through with fewer questions than usual, and Benny drew more attention than trouble.

Cabin handling remained smooth, with the pet cabin running to the expected setting. <<FACT F040>> That helped steady the board during busy departures and kept the desk from having to chase avoidable fixes. The route notes were clear, the lounge alerts landed on time, and the team kept its tone friendly without getting sloppy.

Looking ahead, the next month should be about tightening the same basics and staying quick on exceptions. A few route patterns will need sharper watch, but the desk is in good shape and ready to keep the flow moving. Companion Animal Travel Desk
